def maximumMatch(G):
    M = len(G)  # Number of applicants
    N = len(G[0])  # Number of jobs
    
    # Initialize the job assignment array
    job_assignment = [-1] * N
    
    # Function to check if a job can be assigned to an applicant
    def is_safe(applicant, job, visited):
        for j in range(N):
            if G[applicant][j] and not visited[j]:
                visited[j] = True
                if job_assignment[j] == -1 or is_safe(job_assignment[j], j, visited):
                    job_assignment[j] = applicant
                    return True
        return False
    
    # Count the number of applicants who can get a job
    result = 0
    for i in range(M):
        visited = [False] * N
        if is_safe(i, -1, visited):
            result += 1
    
    return result
